name: Valen Mod Pack (Modern EE/EET Edition)
author: Weimer (Original), Modernization by /u/celestialfury
description: A fully modernized, modular, EE/EET-compatible version of the classic Valen mod. This edition rebuilds the technical foundation for modern WeiDU, featuring per-dialogue TRA scoping, layered language TRAs with automatic English fallback across ten languages, localized component names, explicit CRE field writes for the joinable Valen NPC via the reusable EE_SET_CRE_FIELDS helper, a CRE v1.0 format guard on all binary writes, removal of the Noober-era audio purge, load-order-safe 2DA patches, and bulletproofed ToB epilogues.

components.name: Valen: Core NPC
components.description: Installs Valen as a joinable party companion. This component includes critical modernizations: explicit field writes for Valen's Dialogue resref, script resrefs, script name, and known-spells table (fixing the corrupted Dialogue resref at 0x2CC and the one-byte-misaligned known-spells table at 0x2D4), a CRE v1.0 format guard on every binary write, removal of the Noober-era audio purge that was silently muting Valen's sound slots, lowercase normalization of script resrefs and death variables for cross-platform safety, vampire hunter script strref resolution, cutscene hardening on the main AI script, area and priest-script extensions, and load-order-safe 2DA patches guarded by BUT_ONLY_IF_IT_CHANGES.

components.name: Give More Creatures Protection From Level Drain & Undead
components.description: An independent tweak that grants level drain immunity items to inherently-undead-immune creatures (golems, elementals, demons, slimes, mists, and specific animations) and protection from undead items to select priest and paladin-type NPCs. Scans every v1.0 CRE in override/, not a fixed list. Party NPCs are excluded. v2.2 CREs are intentionally skipped because the race/class byte offsets used (0x272/0x273) are v1.0-specific and have not been field-by-field verified against the v2.2 layout.

conflicts.description: Cannot coexist with older legacy non-EE versions of the Valen mod.
